As AI invades every aspect of our lives we  need to be aware of just how insidious it really is.

Researchers have found that ChatGPT is secretly writing a psychological profile of every user. Researchers discovered that it is actively reading between the lines to deduce our personality traits, anxieties, demographics, and behavioral patterns. This is an invisible, autonomous background process.

When we ask it to debug a python script, or write an essay, it analyzes our syntax, prompt frequency, and hesitation markers to map out our psychological footprint.

The paper shows that the model builds a persistent "user state" that tracks our emotional baseline over time. Every innocent prompt. Every late-night question. Every "help me understand this" query, is all being used to build a shadow profile of our mind in real-time. And none of this is for our benefit. This is personal information being stored to be used to manipulate us. 

#AI #ChatGPT #Tech
